verdict.rationale: Community Phone's Business Team plan lists a "Dial menu" and live transfer, plus a shared team business number [community-phone-docs-20]. Business plans also advertise call routing, advanced call routing, and simultaneous or rollover ringing [community-phone-docs-18, docs-21, docs-16]. Together these outline a press-a-key menu that routes callers, but the evidence is only feature-list bullets, with no detail on how menu options are configured or mapped to teams. Missing for 10: documentation on configuring menu options (e.g. press 1 for sales), mapping options to team or ring groups, menu depth and limits, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
